name: cropx/six-column-icons
title: 6-Column Text with Icons
description: Optional eyebrow + heading above a 6-column grid. Each column has an icon box, sub-heading, body, and a CTA link. Columns can be reordered. Supports white and Deep Blue backgrounds with per-segment icon box accent tinting on white sections.
